bar.neutral: neutral heads outside the band are allowed and counted
bar.population_30_or_fewer: every head is read; 0 wrong -> PASS; 1 or more wrong -> FAIL -> SWITCH OFF (no further heads exist to continue into: C8 "fewer than 30: read all at 0 wrong")
bar.population_31_to_59: as above; the continuation is every head that remains after the first 30 (fewer than 30)
bar.population_over_30: 0 wrong of the first 30 (sha256(salt + id) ascending) -> PASS; exactly 1 wrong -> read the continuation (the next 30 in the same order, or every remaining head if fewer than 30 remain), which must hold 0 wrong (<= 1 of 60 in all); 2 or more wrong -> FAIL -> SWITCH OFF
bar.protocol: a reader + an adversarial skeptic per head, a third reader on disagreement (wf_dc85fa7e-c00's rubric); readers get the served head (S = current_value_cents, currency, n = detail.lots, vouched_by), the Tender and its notices; no port prediction exists for these heads
